title: My Son Sanctuary Sunrise Tour (Hoi An)
description: Witness sunrise over the UNESCO-listed My Son Champa Sanctuary with a private historian before teeing off on Vietnam's Central Coast golf courses.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   The My Son Sanctuary Sunrise Tour, a 4-hour experience departing Hoi An at 5:00 AM via private SUV, offers exclusive access to the 4th-14th century Champa Kingdom Hindu temples before general crowds. This allows for exploration of red-brick temples and Sanskrit inscriptions with a specialist historian guide.
> *   This luxury tour, available year-round with advance booking, includes private SUV transfers and a breakfast box amongst the ruins, emphasizing a serene, historical, and spiritual atmosphere with moderate physical demand. It is designed to bypass logistical friction for a high-standard experience.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Witness the sun illuminating the ancient Hindu temples of the Champa Kingdom before the crowds arrive. This profound spiritual site offers a deeply moving glimpse into Central [Vietnam](/destinations/vietnam/)'s pre-colonial heritage.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Constructed between the 4th and 14th centuries, My Son was the religious and political capital of the Champa Kingdom. Often compared to [Angkor Wat](https://whc.unesco.org/) or Bagan, its history is a testament to the complex spiritual evolution of Central Vietnam.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Departing Hoi An at 5:00 AM in a private SUV, you arrive as the gates open. A specialist historian guide walks you through the atmospheric, mist-covered valley. 

You will explore the intricate red-brick temples, decoding the Sanskrit inscriptions before enjoying a peaceful breakfast box amongst the ruins.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Spiritual, Historical, Serene |
| **Duration** | 4 Hours (Dawn) |
| **Physical Demand** | Moderate (Walking on uneven trails) |
| **Best Paired With** | A relaxed afternoon in Hoi An. |

## Pairing Dawn at the Champa Sanctuary With Afternoon Recovery or Twilight Golf
Nestled inside a lush green volcanic amphitheater surrounded by Cat’s Tooth Mountain (*Hòn Quắp*) 45 minutes southwest of Hoi An, the UNESCO World Heritage **My Son Sanctuary** served as the spiritual imperial heart of the Hindu Champa Kingdom from the 4th to the 14th centuries. Because the valley floor traps midday heat after 9:30 AM—and attracts coach crowds from Da Nang—our **5:00 AM Sunrise Scholar Departure** from [Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai](/accommodations/vietnam/four-seasons-nam-hai/), [Anantara Hoi An Resort](/accommodations/vietnam/anantara-hoi-an/), [Namia River Retreat](/accommodations/vietnam/namia-river-retreat-hoi-an/), or our [An Bang Beachfront Villas](/accommodations/vietnam/an-bang-beach-villas/) gets your group through the park gates at 6:00 AM sharp when morning mist still hangs over the mortarless red-brick Shiva temples (Groups B, C, D, and G).

## How to Slot My Son Into a 4-Round Central Coast Golf Week
* **Morning Heritage & Afternoon Pool Villa Rest:** Because you return to Hoi An or An Bang Beach by 9:30 AM—having enjoyed an artisanal breakfast box and Vietnamese drip coffee beside the ruins—you have the entire remainder of the day free for a deep-tissue spa treatment, bespoke suit fitting in Hoi An, or beach lounging between rounds at [Hoiana Shores Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/hoiana-shores/) and [Vinpearl Golf Nam Hoi An](/courses/vietnam/vinpearl-nam-hoi-an/).
* **Optional Twilight floodlit Golf at Ba Na Hills or BRG Nicklaus:** For dedicated golfers who want both UNESCO history and 18 holes on the same day, follow a three-hour midday sleep at your villa with a 2:30 PM tee time on the floodlit [BRG Da Nang Nicklaus Course](/courses/vietnam/brg-da-nang-nicklaus/) or [Ba Na Hills Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/ba-na-hills/).

## Pairing My Son’s Cham Heritage With Hoi An’s Championship Links & Luxury Resorts
Whether your group is based in a private beachfront pool villa at [An Bang Holiday Villa](/accommodations/vietnam/an-bang-beach-villas/) or a riverfront suite at [Namia River Retreat](/accommodations/vietnam/namia-river-retreat-hoi-an/) and [Anantara Hoi An Resort](/accommodations/vietnam/anantara-hoi-an/), returning from My Son Sanctuary by 9:30 AM keeps your legs fresh for the next morning’s coastal wind test at [Hoiana Shores Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/hoiana-shores/), [BRG Da Nang Golf Resort](/courses/vietnam/brg-da-nang-norman/), or [Montgomerie Links](/courses/vietnam/montgomerie-links/) on our [Hoi An Beachfront Bliss](/tours/hoi-an-beachfront-bliss/) itinerary.

faqs.q: How far is My Son Sanctuary from Hoi An's luxury resorts and Hoiana Shores Golf Club?
faqs.a: My Son Sanctuary is a 45-to-50-minute chauffeured SUV drive southwest of Hoi An Ancient Town, An Bang Beachfront Villas, Four Seasons The Nam Hai, and Hoiana Shores Golf Club.

faqs.q: Why is the 5:00 AM sunrise departure essential for visiting My Son Sanctuary?
faqs.a: Entering My Son at 6:00 AM lets your group explore the 10th-century Cham brick temples in cool 22°C mountain mist with zero tour-bus crowds, returning to your Hoi An hotel by 9:30 AM before midday valley temperatures rise.

faqs.q: Should we play morning golf on the same day as the My Son Sunrise Tour?
faqs.a: We recommend scheduling the My Son Sunrise Tour on a non-golf recovery morning between rounds at Hoiana Shores and Montgomerie Links, or pairing it with an afternoon rest followed by floodlit twilight golf at BRG Da Nang Nicklaus Course.
